symmetry.representative_rule: retain one sign representative per nonzero amplitude

admission_rule: ADMIT(A) = MAG1(A) and SW-GEOM(A) and EQRES(A)

known_admission_definitions.SW-GEOM: positive thickness and deformation remains inside the externally frozen shallow-water thin-shell geometry regime
known_admission_definitions.EQRES: the frozen B1 equilibrium residual must satisfy the preregistered arithmetic tolerance

admission_execution_status.reason: The recovered frozen project record contains the predicates and their meanings but not the numerical thin-shell or EQRES thresholds. No threshold is invented here.

provenance.project_preregistration: BURGAMOTS_MAGNETIC_PRIOR_v1 was frozen before BURGAMOTS response execution.
provenance.100_kG_anchor: Independent tachocline/flux-tube literature commonly uses ~10^5 G as the strong toroidal field scale required for low-latitude emergence/Joy-law consistency.
provenance.300_kG_anchor: Modern tachocline review reports a helioseismic upper limit below 30 T (~300 kG); retained as an upper-envelope anchor, not a field measurement.
provenance.50_kG_anchor: Preregistered intermediate strong-field regime anchor; not an observational field measurement.

outcome_independence.selection_basis: Frozen physical-prior family and external tachocline literature; no BURGAMOTS response exists.
